title_en: The Virtue of the Three Months: Rajab, Sha'ban, and Ramadan
description_en: Excerpts from an advanced jurisprudence (bahth al-kharij) lesson by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure) on the first day of the blessed month of Rajab 1434.
summary: His Eminence discusses the spiritual virtues of the three sacred months of Rajab, Sha'ban, and Ramadan in an advanced jurisprudence lesson.
